carbon_policy_signal.item: EU court rejects Poland's bid to overturn seven major climate laws; ETS compliance and carbon regulations confirmed intact.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Confirms EUA regulatory certainty through 2027 calendar; reduces whipsaw risk and supports carbon floor for power marginal-cost hedging.

freshness_caveat: Coal (322 days old, as of 2025-12-26) and Clean Dark (317 days old, as of 2025-12-31) are stale; coal merit-order and thermal economics inference unreliable until refreshed. GB Power, DE Power, EUA, Storage current as of 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-13.

EU Storage 17.7pp below seasonal average — refill pace through H1 2027 sets marginal gas cost and fuel-switch regime.

base.summary: GB supply tightness persists; EU storage refill steady; Spain election outcome uncertain.

downside.summary: Spain socialists maintain power; GB supply normalizes; EU storage refill accelerates on mild weather.

upside.summary: Spain conservatives win, relax RES rules; EU wind output drops; storage refill slows further.

themes: GB power spike amid storage deficit
